TA0072.title: Communications Abuse Service Provider
TA0072.description: An individual or group that builds or operates SMS bombing, Automated Calling Platforms, bulk verification-code reception, or illicit phone-SIM distribution services for malicious user harassment, coercive debt collection, telecom fraud, and account abuse. Operators combine modem pools, voice trunks, and bulk-dialing capacity, packaging unregistered or fraudulently registered SIM cards, messaging APIs, and calling channels into underground services. They rotate numbers and call exits to evade carrier blocking. This role supplies communications infrastructure rather than conducting scam conversations directly.
